title: Same names reused for generic broker/clerk roles in far-apart towns… @ unmapped
excerpts: Civic Center POIs/events across multiple towns (Albany, Saratoga Springs, Queensbury, Rome, Oswego)
Contact lists in unrelated towns (e.g. Rowan Quill in Albany/Queensbury, Hayden Hale in Albany/Oneonta, Avery Lowell in Rome/Greece)
Recurring civic-contact NPCs (e.g. Hayden Hale, Rowan Quill) across unrelated towns/regions
Same names reused for generic broker/clerk roles in far-apart towns reads as the same person and briefly breaks immersion.
Identical 'charter backlog' event titles and reused generic NPC names reduce per-town distinctiveness.
